description: A thin one-line strip above the page content with a short message and a link, shown between a start and end date. For time-limited notices.

agentGuidance.useWhen: A one-line notice above the page content, with an optional link, shown between a start date and an end date: closures, launches, upcoming events.
agentGuidance.avoidWhen: A full call-to-action section (use CTABanner) or a page opener (use a hero).

alternatives.when: a full section with a heading and buttons
